summary: Ferrovial N.V., a foreign private issuer, filed Form 6-K reporting weekly repurchase transactions from July 27 to August 28, 2026, under a share repurchase program launched December 15, 2025. Five press releases cover periodic purchases on U.S. and other venues, with 5,880,574 shares repurchased for €341.7 million as of July 31, 2026. This is routine market buyback activity, not a special-situation event such as a tender offer or capital return program. No board recommendation, advisors, or structural terms are disclosed; watch for continued periodic updates on repurchase progress.
